title: Q-YEAR-progress-loop: the tick acts on a still week and counts every tenant
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** UNATTENDED-365 register, dependency `progress-loop` is open
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation unattended --probe progress-loop
**Status:** open

In the tick Worker, read the progress windows (site/live.js `progressReading` logic over `live_changes`) each pass: when the day window holds no change started by the system, raise the executor's next item to the front and file one `PROGRESS-STILL` item that closes itself when a system-started change merges. Refresh `live_changes` for every repository of the org and every tenant system and return the windows per system from `/api/v1/progress`, so a tenant that stops moving is a 503 for that tenant.
When it holds, set the dependency's status to closed in doctrine/unattended.json with the evidence and a probe that resolves.
